footnote_text: Reported amount includes 208,509 shares of Class A Common Stock and 510,029 restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted under the Sky Harbour Group Corporation 2022 Incentive Award Plan. Each RSU represents the contingent right to receive, in accordance with the terms of the applicable RSU agreement, one share of Class A Common Stock of the Issuer for each vested RSU. The RSUs vest in installments in accordance with the terms of the applicable RSU agreement, provided the reporting person remains in service through the applicable vesting date.
